verdict.rationale: YYLO's own docs show some explicit model choice: it delegates work 'across agents and models', and its benchmark lane binds 'model selectors' before execution. The `--subagent claude` flag picks an agent, not a model. Nothing documents an automatic model-selection mode or a way to override it with a specific model for normal tasks. missing for 10: documented automatic model selection mode, documented flag/config to pin a specific model for regular task runs, examples of switching between auto and manual selection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice

citations.quote: Delegate bounded work across agents and models.
Bind cases, model selectors, attempts and evaluator configuration before execution.
